The Patient Education and Engagement Program at the University Health Network (UHN) is dedicated to providing you with the materials and resources you need to be a well-informed patient. Health information is an important part of your care. 

The information within the videos on this YouTube Channel are not intended to replace any advice provided to you by your health care team. For your safety, please do not act on the information within these videos without first discussing your treatment or healthy living plan with your qualified health care providers. 

UHN Patient Education & Engagement Program encourages you to ask questions, find information and become informed about your care.

To learn more about our Program, visit http://www.uhnpatienteducation.ca.
